Pattern gallery, page 3 of 8 (15-minute bars, MES / MNQ / MYM)

Purple circle = the detected pattern; yellow = its bars; light blue = the 5 bars after; arrow = entry at the next open to the close 5 bars later. EMA 8 red, 20 orange, 50 blue; VWAP light blue; dots = 3-bar swing points, diamonds = 10-bar swing points (only those already confirmed when the pattern appears). Momentum(14) below.

harami (bullish)

Rule: body1 > avgB10, body2 <= avgB10, body2 strictly inside body1; bullish if bar1 down and close1 < EMA10, bearish mirror. 12,484 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

harami (bearish)

Rule: body1 > avgB10, body2 <= avgB10, body2 strictly inside body1; bullish if bar1 down and close1 < EMA10, bearish mirror. 13,412 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

piercing (bullish)

Rule: bar1 down with body > avgB10, bar2 opens <= close1 and closes above the middle of body1 but below open1 -> bullish. 15,266 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

dark cloud (bearish)

Rule: mirror of piercing -> bearish. 14,231 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

morning evening star (bullish)

Rule: TA-Lib style 3 bars: long body 1, small body 2 gapping beyond body 1, long body 3 closing beyond 30% into body 1; morning (bullish) after close1 < EMA10, evening mirror. 2,015 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

morning evening star (bearish)

Rule: TA-Lib style 3 bars: long body 1, small body 2 gapping beyond body 1, long body 3 closing beyond 30% into body 1; morning (bullish) after close1 < EMA10, evening mirror. 2,003 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
